meaning.zh:
“尚无定论” 或 “悬而未决”。

这个短语源自法律术语，当陪审团（jury）在讨论判决尚未做决定之前，我们说 “jury is still out”。在日常用语中，这个成语被用来表示某件事情或某个问题尚未最终确定，仍有待观察或讨论。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from legal terminology, where it refers to the time before a jury has reached a verdict. In everyday language, it is used to indicate that something is still undecided or remains to be seen.

lines.en: The *jury is still out* on whether the new policy will be effective.
lines.zh: 关于新政策是否有效尚无定论。

lines.en: The *jury is still out* regarding the success of the new product.
lines.zh: 新产品是否成功尚无定论。

lines.en: We can't make a decision yet; the *jury is still out* on this issue.
lines.zh: 我们还不能做决定，这个问题尚无定论。
